purpose: Player-facing semantic metadata for country and territory cases where a single generic capital label or geographic rendering could misstate political, constitutional, administrative or recognition reality.

eu-kosovo-status-neutral.title: Framework Agreement between the European Union and Kosovo* on participation in Union programmes
eu-kosovo-status-neutral.note: The EU designation states that use of Kosovo* is without prejudice to positions on status and is aligned with UNSCR 1244 (1999) and the ICJ opinion.

eu-cyprus-green-line.title: Green Line Regulation
eu-cyprus-green-line.note: The Commission states that the whole of Cyprus is in the EU and that EU legislation is suspended in the northern part where the Government of the Republic of Cyprus does not exercise effective control.

eu-cyprus-protocol-10.title: Protocol No 10 on Cyprus to the 2003 Act of Accession
eu-cyprus-protocol-10.note: Protocol 10 suspends the acquis in areas of the Republic of Cyprus where its Government does not exercise effective control, pending a settlement.

un-somaliland-governance.title: Final consultation on key local government law takes place in Hargeisa
un-somaliland-governance.note: UN-supported programming documents Somaliland ministries, parliament and local-government administration without treating programmatic geography as a sovereignty determination.

un-somaliland-recognition-briefing.publisher: United Nations Department of Political and Peacebuilding Affairs
un-somaliland-recognition-briefing.title: Security Council briefing following Israel's recognition of Somaliland
un-somaliland-recognition-briefing.note: The briefing records Israel's 26 December 2025 recognition, Somaliland's response, and Somalia's rejection and sovereignty position.

israel-knesset-somaliland.title: Knesset Speaker to visiting Somaliland President
israel-knesset-somaliland.note: The Knesset describes Israel's official recognition of Somaliland on 26 December 2025 and subsequent diplomatic relations.

japan-government-profile.title: About Japan
japan-government-profile.note: The current JapanGov country profile identifies Tokyo as Japan's capital.

myanmar-moi-capital.title: Nay Pyi Taw capital must be neat and tidy with operation of smokeless industries
myanmar-moi-capital.note: The Ministry identifies Nay Pyi Taw as the capital and Yangon as a commercial hub.

sri-lanka-government-overview.title: Country Overview
sri-lanka-government-overview.note: The government overview identifies Sri Jayewardenepura as the capital and Colombo as the commercial capital.

chile-government-santiago.title: Región Metropolitana
chile-government-santiago.note: The Government of Chile identifies Santiago as both the regional capital and the national capital.

chile-senate-valparaiso.title: Edificio del Congreso Nacional de Valparaíso
chile-senate-valparaiso.note: The Senate describes the National Congress building in Valparaíso and its Senate and Chamber session halls.

equatorial-guinea-decree-2026.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea
equatorial-guinea-decree-2026.title: Decreto Ley por el que se declara la Ciudad de la Paz, Djibloho, capital de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
equatorial-guinea-decree-2026.note: Decree-Law No. 1/2026 declares Ciudad de la Paz the capital and gives state institutions one year from entry into force to take measures for their transfer and effective establishment in the new capital.

uk-pcgn-equatorial-guinea-2026.publisher: UK Permanent Committee on Geographical Names (PCGN)
uk-pcgn-equatorial-guinea-2026.title: Equatorial Guinea: Toponymic Factfile
uk-pcgn-equatorial-guinea-2026.note: The official factfile lists Ciudad de la Paz as the administrative centre of Djibloho at 01°35′33″N 10°49′25″E, states that it was formerly known as Oyala, and records its January 2026 capital status.

south-africa-government-capitals.title: South Africa at a glance
south-africa-government-capitals.note: The South African Government lists Pretoria as the administrative capital, Cape Town as the legislative capital and Bloemfontein as the judicial capital, and states that the Constitutional Court is located in Johannesburg.

tanzania-dodoma-capital-act.publisher: Office of the Attorney General, United Republic of Tanzania
tanzania-dodoma-capital-act.title: The Dodoma Capital City (Declaration) Act, 2018
tanzania-dodoma-capital-act.note: Act No. 5 of 2018 declares Dodoma the Capital City of the United Republic of Tanzania and records the national decision to establish the capital at Dodoma.

tanzania-government-country-profile.publisher: Permanent Mission of the United Republic of Tanzania to the United Nations
tanzania-government-country-profile.title: About Tanzania
tanzania-government-country-profile.note: The official Tanzania profile identifies Dodoma as the capital city and Dar es Salaam as the commercial capital and major seaport for Tanzania Mainland.

un-western-sahara-nsgt.title: Western Sahara
un-western-sahara-nsgt.note: The United Nations lists Western Sahara as a Non-Self-Governing Territory since 1963 and treats the question as an unfinished decolonization matter rather than a settled sovereignty outcome.

un-western-sahara-working-paper-2026.publisher: United Nations Special Committee on Decolonization
un-western-sahara-working-paper-2026.title: Working papers on Non-Self-Governing Territories — Western Sahara, 2026 session
un-western-sahara-working-paper-2026.note: The 2026 C-24 working-paper index lists A/AC.109/2026/17 for Western Sahara, confirming that the Territory remains on the Committee's active 2026 agenda.

un-minurso-current.title: MINURSO Fact Sheet
un-minurso-current.note: MINURSO remains the United Nations Mission for the Referendum in Western Sahara and continues operating with Morocco and Frente Polisario as parties to the unresolved settlement process.

benin-porto-novo-capital.publisher: Ministry of Decentralization and Local Governance, Republic of Benin
benin-porto-novo-capital.title: Porto-Novo
benin-porto-novo-capital.note: The official commune profile states that Porto-Novo retained its capital status after Benin independence and hosts major national political institutions.

benin-cotonou-economic-capital.publisher: Government of the Republic of Benin
benin-cotonou-economic-capital.title: Cité ministérielle de Cotonou : Le nouveau symbole d’une administration moderne et intégrée
benin-cotonou-economic-capital.note: The Government describes Cotonou as Benin’s economic capital and records the ministerial city hosting sixteen ministerial cabinets and central services.

burundi-presidency-capitals.publisher: Presidency of the Republic of Burundi
burundi-presidency-capitals.title: Le Pays
burundi-presidency-capitals.note: The Presidency identifies Gitega as the political capital and Bujumbura as the economic capital.

cote-divoire-economic-diplomacy-capitals.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, Republic of Côte d’Ivoire
cote-divoire-economic-diplomacy-capitals.title: Economic Diplomacy Platform — General data
cote-divoire-economic-diplomacy-capitals.note: The official economic-diplomacy profile identifies Yamoussoukro as the political capital and Abidjan as the economic capital.

bolivia-oep-constitution.title: Constitución Política del Estado
bolivia-oep-constitution.note: The OEP publishes the current 2009 Constitution as Bolivia’s fundamental legal norm; current Bolivian institutional material identifies Sucre as the constitutional capital.

bolivia-deputies-sucre-capital.publisher: Cámara de Diputados, Asamblea Legislativa Plurinacional de Bolivia
bolivia-deputies-sucre-capital.title: Autoridades nacionales participan de actos protocolares conmemorando los 199 años de independencia de Bolivia
bolivia-deputies-sucre-capital.note: The Chamber of Deputies explicitly describes Sucre as the constitutional capital of Bolivia.

bolivia-legislative-government-seat.publisher: Cámara de Diputados, Asamblea Legislativa Plurinacional de Bolivia
bolivia-legislative-government-seat.title: Memoria histórica del nuevo edificio de la Asamblea Legislativa Plurinacional
bolivia-legislative-government-seat.note: The legislative institutional history identifies La Paz as Bolivia’s political centre, locating the Executive and Legislative branches and the President’s residence there, while Sucre is the capital and judicial seat.

israel-knesset-jerusalem-basic-law.title: Basic Laws of the State of Israel — Basic-Law: Jerusalem, the Capital of Israel
israel-knesset-jerusalem-basic-law.note: The Knesset states that Israeli Basic Law establishes Jerusalem as Israel’s capital and the seat of the President, Knesset, Government and Supreme Court.

un-sg-jerusalem-two-state-2026.title: Implementation of Security Council resolution 2334 (2016) — Report of the Secretary-General
un-sg-jerusalem-two-state-2026.note: The Secretary-General reiterates the UN two-State vision based on pre-1967 lines with Jerusalem as the capital of both States, and the report treats East Jerusalem as part of the Palestinian territory occupied since 1967.

un-palestine-undata-capital.title: UNData country profile — State of Palestine
un-palestine-undata-capital.note: UNData lists East Jerusalem as the capital city designation provided by the State of Palestine and explicitly notes that the United Nations position on Jerusalem is governed by relevant General Assembly and Security Council resolutions.

palestine-basic-law-jerusalem.publisher: Palestinian Official Gazette / Bureau of Legal Opinion and Legislation
palestine-basic-law-jerusalem.title: Amended Basic Law
palestine-basic-law-jerusalem.note: Article 3 of the Palestinian Basic Law states that Jerusalem is the capital of Palestine.

palestine-cabinet-headquarters.publisher: Palestinian Official Gazette / Bureau of Legal Opinion and Legislation
palestine-cabinet-headquarters.title: Council of Ministers Decision No. 21 of 2020 on the Prime Ministry system
palestine-cabinet-headquarters.note: Article 2 establishes the principal Council of Ministers headquarters in Jerusalem and temporary headquarters in Ramallah and Gaza; the decision was issued in Ramallah.

un-falkland-malvinas-status.title: Falkland Islands (Malvinas)
un-falkland-malvinas-status.note: The United Nations lists the Falkland Islands (Malvinas) as a Non-Self-Governing Territory, identifies the United Kingdom as administering Power, and explicitly notes a sovereignty dispute between Argentina and the United Kingdom.

un-c24-falkland-malvinas-2026.publisher: United Nations Special Committee on Decolonization
un-c24-falkland-malvinas-2026.title: C-24 2026 session — Question of the Falkland Islands (Malvinas)
un-c24-falkland-malvinas-2026.note: The 2026 C-24 session continued formal consideration of the Question of the Falkland Islands (Malvinas), including the sovereignty dispute between Argentina and the United Kingdom.

antarctic-treaty-article-iv.title: The Antarctic Treaty — Article IV territorial-claim safeguards
antarctic-treaty-article-iv.note: Article IV safeguards existing positions on territorial claims, prevents Treaty-era activities from creating sovereignty rights, and bars new claims or enlargement of existing claims while the Treaty is in force.

nsf-mcmurdo-station.publisher: U.S. National Science Foundation, Office of Polar Programs
nsf-mcmurdo-station.title: NSF McMurdo Station
nsf-mcmurdo-station.note: NSF identifies McMurdo Station as the largest station on Antarctica and the central logistics hub for the U.S. Antarctic Program, supporting scientific research across the continent.

XKX.statusSummary: Status and recognition positions differ internationally. DROPi represents the geography and source-backed localities without taking a sovereignty position.

placeRoles.label: Capital / administrative centre
placeRoles.note: The locality label is geographic and administrative context, not a DROPi sovereignty assertion.

XNC.statusSummary: This geometry covers the northern part of Cyprus where the Government of the Republic of Cyprus does not exercise effective control. EU law is suspended there under Protocol 10 pending a settlement.
XNC.coverageNote: The pinned Natural Earth populated-place source does not currently map representative locality nodes safely to this geometry, so DROPi leaves locality coverage empty rather than inventing places.

XSL.statusSummary: Somaliland has operated through separate de facto institutions. Israel officially recognized Somaliland on 26 December 2025. Wider international status remains contested, and UN proceedings continue to address the issue alongside Somalia's sovereignty and territorial-integrity position.

placeRoles.label: Principal administrative centre
placeRoles.note: The label describes the source-backed gameplay locality and de facto administration without presenting statehood as universally settled.

392.statusSummary: Tokyo is Japan's current national capital. The pinned locality source remains authoritative for coordinates; the governed override corrects which source-backed node carries the current capital role.

104.statusSummary: Nay Pyi Taw is Myanmar's capital. Yangon remains a major commercial hub and is not presented as the national capital.

144.statusSummary: Sri Jayewardenepura Kotte is the administrative/national capital while Colombo is the commercial capital. DROPi represents both roles instead of collapsing them into one generic capital label.

152.statusSummary: Santiago is Chile's national capital. Valparaíso hosts the National Congress and remains represented separately rather than being labeled as the national capital.

226.statusSummary: Ciudad de la Paz became the legal capital of Equatorial Guinea on 2 January 2026. The decree provides a one-year transition for state institutions to take measures for transfer and effective establishment in the new capital, so DROPi keeps Malabo represented as the former capital during the transition rather than erasing it from the Country Layer.

placeRoles.label: National capital
placeRoles.note: Effective 2 January 2026 under Decree-Law No. 1/2026. The locality coordinate comes from the governed PCGN authoritative supplement because the pinned Natural Earth snapshot predates this locality/capital representation.

710.statusSummary: South Africa has three capitals with distinct national functions: Pretoria is the administrative capital, Cape Town is the legislative capital and Bloemfontein is the judicial capital. Johannesburg remains a major national city and hosts the Constitutional Court, but DROPi does not present it as the sole national capital.

placeRoles.label: Judicial capital / Supreme Court of Appeal

834.statusSummary: Dodoma is Tanzania’s national capital. Dar es Salaam remains the commercial capital and major seaport for Tanzania Mainland, so DROPi retains it as a major strategic city without presenting it as the national capital.

732.statusSummary: Western Sahara has remained on the United Nations list of Non-Self-Governing Territories since 1963. Its final status remains unresolved, and MINURSO continues operating in the Territory in the context of the settlement process involving Morocco and Frente Polisario. DROPi renders the geography and its source-backed locality without choosing a sovereignty or governance claim.

territoryStatus.label: UN Non-Self-Governing Territory
territoryStatus.note: Geographic chapter placement and sparse locality roles do not adjudicate sovereignty, recognition, administration or final status.

placeRoles.label: Source-backed representative locality
placeRoles.note: The Natural Earth locality is retained for sparse geographic representation. DROPi does not surface its structural source capital flag as an uncontested national-capital claim.

204.statusSummary: Porto-Novo is Benin’s national and political capital. Cotonou is the economic capital and hosts major central-government services, so DROPi represents both roles instead of treating Cotonou as the sole national capital.

108.statusSummary: Gitega is Burundi’s political capital and Bujumbura is its economic capital. DROPi keeps both cities visible with distinct roles.

384.statusSummary: Yamoussoukro is Côte d’Ivoire’s political capital and Abidjan is its economic capital. DROPi represents the two roles separately rather than preserving Abidjan as the sole capital.

068.statusSummary: Sucre is Bolivia’s constitutional/national capital. La Paz is the principal seat of government and political centre where the Executive and Legislative branches operate. DROPi represents both roles instead of treating La Paz as the sole national capital.

376.statusSummary: Israeli Basic Law defines Jerusalem as Israel’s capital and seat of its principal state institutions. The United Nations continues to treat East Jerusalem as occupied Palestinian territory and supports a negotiated two-State outcome with Jerusalem as the capital of both States. DROPi records the Israeli institutional role without asserting a unilateral settlement of Jerusalem’s final territorial status.

territoryStatus.label: Jerusalem final-status sensitive geography
territoryStatus.note: The structural locality role is not a DROPi sovereignty determination.

placeRoles.label: Capital under Israeli law / seat of state institutions
placeRoles.note: This label records Israel’s domestic legal and institutional role while the status summary preserves the UN final-status context.

275.statusLabel: East Jerusalem capital designation / final-status sensitive case
275.statusSummary: Palestinian law identifies Jerusalem as the capital of Palestine, and UNData records East Jerusalem as the capital designation provided by the State of Palestine while noting the separate United Nations position on Jerusalem. Palestinian regulations provide temporary Council of Ministers headquarters in Ramallah and Gaza. DROPi represents these roles without asserting a unilateral settlement of Jerusalem’s final territorial status.

territoryStatus.label: East Jerusalem final-status sensitive geography
territoryStatus.note: The East Jerusalem role is semantic/status metadata and is not fabricated as a locality marker where the pinned country-locality source does not safely assign it to geometry 275.

placeRoles.label: Capital designated by State of Palestine / status sensitive
placeRoles.note: Semantic role only; DROPi does not fabricate a duplicate marker for East Jerusalem.

238.statusSummary: The United Nations lists the Falkland Islands (Malvinas) as a Non-Self-Governing Territory administered by the United Kingdom and explicitly records an unresolved sovereignty dispute between Argentina and the United Kingdom. DROPi preserves the current geographic/locality layer without deciding final sovereignty.

territoryStatus.label: UN Non-Self-Governing Territory / sovereignty dispute unresolved
territoryStatus.note: Geographic rendering, local administration and company activity do not constitute a DROPi sovereignty determination.

238.coverageNote: Stanley remains a source-backed locality and current administrative centre in the sparse map; that administrative role is not a final sovereignty judgment.

placeRoles.label: Current administrative centre
placeRoles.note: Administrative-centre labeling describes present local administration only and does not resolve the sovereignty dispute.

010.statusLabel: Antarctic Treaty geography / no national capital
010.statusSummary: Antarctica has no sovereign national capital in DROPi. The Antarctic Treaty preserves Parties’ differing positions on territorial claims and prevents Treaty-era activities from creating new sovereignty rights. Research stations are scientific and logistics facilities, not national capitals.

territoryStatus.label: Antarctic Treaty System / sovereignty positions safeguarded
territoryStatus.note: DROPi does not adjudicate Antarctic territorial claims; station presence and operations do not alter sovereignty.

010.coverageNote: The sparse map keeps the pinned Natural Earth Antarctic facility/locality nodes and overrides their player-facing meaning without changing source coordinates.

placeRoles.label: Research / logistics station
placeRoles.note: NSF describes McMurdo as Antarctica’s largest station and the central logistics hub for the U.S. Antarctic Program.

placeRoles.label: Research station
placeRoles.note: The locality name is preserved exactly from the pinned Natural Earth source.
